content: VS Code: layered src/vs with base, platform, workbench, code. Dependency injection is constructor injection using a ServiceIdentifier created by createDecorator plus registerSingleton. IInstantiationService.createChild gives scoped service collections with ownership and disposal. Contributions are declarative, registered by unique string id in the contributes field. JupyterLab is the lighter analog: Token objects, plugin declares requires and optional token arrays, activate(app, ...resolvedServices), autoStart flag. Steal the typed-token idea, not the runtime.
